[reshared post by AMD Data Center]
AI clusters are only as fast as the network connecting them. That is why we built something groundbreaking.
The AMD Pensando Vulcano 800 AI NIC is the only AI NIC delivering up to 2.4 Tbps of scale-out bandwidth per GPU on its unique 3 NICs-per-GPU configuration, cutting AI job completion time by up to 13% and purpose-built for AMD Helios.
The network is no longer the bottleneck. Learn all about our next-gen 800G AI NIC here:
https://bit.ly/4wpFnjY
